title: run(): Chat/get + Contact/get on startup
description:
What: After session init in run(), call Chat/get and Contact/get to replace placeholder data with live JMAP data.

Algorithm:
1. In event::run(), immediately after the initial terminal draw, build a JmapRequest with two method_calls:
   a. ["Chat/get", {"accountId": "a-self"}, "c0"] (ids absent = all chats)
   b. ["Contact/get", {"accountId": "a-self"}, "c1"] (ids absent = all contacts)
2. Call client::call_jmap(&http_client, &api_url, &req).await.
3. Parse method_responses[0] (Chat/get): deserialize args Value as {list: Vec<serde_json::Value>, state: String}. For each chat Value, extract id:String, kind:String, participants:Vec<String>, unreadCount:u32.
4. Parse method_responses[1] (Contact/get): deserialize args Value as {list: Vec<serde_json::Value>}. For each contact, extract id:String and compute display name: displayName field if present and non-empty, else login field, else id.
5. Build state.contacts: HashMap<String,String> = { contact_id -> display_name }.
6. Build state.chat_ids: Vec<String> from chat ids.
7. Build state.chat_list: Vec<String> for display:
   - For kind=="direct": look up each participant in contacts map; join with ", " if multiple; sanitize_display.
   - For kind=="group": use "Group" + participant count.
   - Append unread count if > 0: format!("{}  ({})", name, unread_count).
8. Clear placeholder: state.chat_list replaces the hardcoded values; state.chat_ids populated.
9. Clamp state.selected_chat to 0 if list is shorter.
10. If call_jmap returns error: set state.connection_status = Error, leave placeholders cleared to empty.

Defensive programming rules:
- All serde parsing via serde_json::from_value — on error, log and skip the item (never panic).
- sanitize_display() on all contact display names before storing.
- Handle empty list (0 chats) gracefully — no panic, empty chat_list.
- Never unwrap() on the Value extractions; use get().and_then().

Agent team: R reads event.rs, app.rs, client.rs, kith-core/chat.rs; I implements; T writes wiremock tests; V runs cargo test + clippy.

Tests (wiremock oracle):
- Mock Chat/get returning [{id:"abc",kind:"direct",participants:["c-1"],unreadCount:2}] + Contact/get returning [{id:"c-1",login:"alice@x",displayName:"Alice"}] -> state.chat_list=["Alice (2)"], state.chat_ids=["abc"].
- Mock Chat/get returning empty list -> state.chat_list=[], state.chat_ids=[], no panic.
- Mock Chat/get with ANSI in contact name -> sanitize_display strips escapes.
